taxonomyRules.blockbuster: straight-letterform plus block-fit/scale/coverage context; not an exclusive alphabet

A.structuralBasis: apex; two legs; crossbar; triangular counter
A.protectedIdentity: protect apex and two-leg identity; preserve counter unless named topology variant
A.bubbleCandidate: round/soften apex and terminals; controlled mass expansion; counter clearance
A.straightBlockCandidate: straighten or clip apex/junctions; disciplined stem and crossbar hierarchy
A.wildstyleCandidate: diagonal leg rhythm; crossbar/leg anchor candidates; interlock only after counter-safe validation

B.protectedIdentity: preserve spine attachment and two distinct counters
B.bubbleCandidate: round bowls independently; retain upper/lower distinction
B.straightBlockCandidate: square bowl transitions; align spine and bar hierarchy
B.wildstyleCandidate: bowl/spine anchors and selective overlaps; protect both counters

C.structuralBasis: open curve; two terminals; open aperture
C.protectedIdentity: preserve open aperture and terminal direction
C.bubbleCandidate: continuous rounded curve; soften terminals without closing opening
C.wildstyleCandidate: terminal-led extensions and open-channel flow; no forced closure

D.bubbleCandidate: round bowl and transition; maintain broad negative space
D.straightBlockCandidate: straight spine and squared bowl transitions

E.protectedIdentity: preserve three-bar hierarchy and bar attachments
E.bubbleCandidate: softened bar ends and junctions; optional bar curvature
E.straightBlockCandidate: straight bar alignment and deliberate length hierarchy
E.wildstyleCandidate: bar continuation candidates; avoid merging all bars into one mass

F.structuralBasis: spine; upper/middle bars; open lower side
F.protectedIdentity: preserve open lower structure and bar order
F.straightBlockCandidate: straight bar hierarchy; strong top/mid alignment
F.wildstyleCandidate: bar continuation and terminal extensions; keep open side legible

G.protectedIdentity: preserve G-specific aperture and bar logic; do not collapse to C/O
G.bubbleCandidate: rounded bowl while retaining aperture and bar distinction
G.straightBlockCandidate: squared bowl and controlled terminal/bar geometry
G.wildstyleCandidate: aperture-safe terminal connections; no channel blockage

H.protectedIdentity: preserve two stems and crossbar connection
H.bubbleCandidate: round transitions while keeping crossbar legible
H.wildstyleCandidate: crossbar continuation and stem overlaps; preserve interior gap

I.structuralBasis: stem; optional bars/serifs are authored choices
I.protectedIdentity: preserve intentional simplicity; do not invent ornament by default
I.bubbleCandidate: rounded terminal treatment only where authored
I.straightBlockCandidate: straight stem; optional bars remain explicit variant traits
I.wildstyleCandidate: extension only from declared anchors; avoid forced joins

J.structuralBasis: upper terminal; descending stem; curved foot
J.protectedIdentity: preserve descender direction and curve-to-stem transition
J.bubbleCandidate: smooth lower curve and terminal rounding
J.straightBlockCandidate: angular or clipped transition with clear descender
J.wildstyleCandidate: tail/terminal flow into next glyph; avoid false shared stroke

K.protectedIdentity: preserve branch junction and distinct diagonal arms
K.bubbleCandidate: soften acute junctions without closing negative wedges
K.straightBlockCandidate: straight diagonals and controlled branch angle
K.wildstyleCandidate: branch anchors and crossing order; validate wedge clearances

L.protectedIdentity: preserve stem-to-foot connection and foot direction
L.straightBlockCandidate: square foot and stem; proportion foot intentionally
L.wildstyleCandidate: foot continuation or terminal extension; avoid decorative bridge

M.protectedIdentity: preserve central valley and distinct stems
M.bubbleCandidate: round valleys and outer shoulders without collapsing gaps
M.straightBlockCandidate: straight stems/diagonals; consistent but not identical widths
M.wildstyleCandidate: valley/diagonal anchors; preserve internal channels during overlap

N.protectedIdentity: preserve diagonal direction and both junctions
N.straightBlockCandidate: straight stems and diagonal with clear junction hierarchy
N.wildstyleCandidate: diagonal continuation candidates; no ambiguous crossing

O.protectedIdentity: preserve enclosed counter and non-generic silhouette
O.bubbleCandidate: rounded mass with controlled asymmetry; counter clearance
O.wildstyleCandidate: counter-safe overlap; no crossing through protected counter

P.structuralBasis: spine; upper bowl; one counter; open lower termination
P.protectedIdentity: preserve single counter and bowl attachment
P.bubbleCandidate: round upper bowl; maintain open lower structure
P.wildstyleCandidate: bowl and terminal relationships; protect counter

Q.protectedIdentity: preserve counter and explicit tail origin/direction
Q.bubbleCandidate: round contour while keeping tail distinct
Q.straightBlockCandidate: squared contour and controlled tail attachment
Q.wildstyleCandidate: tail may connect outward only from declared anchor; counter protected

R.structuralBasis: spine; bowl; diagonal leg; one counter
R.protectedIdentity: preserve counter, bowl and leg attachment
R.bubbleCandidate: round bowl; keep leg directional and distinct
R.straightBlockCandidate: square bowl; clear leg angle and junction
R.wildstyleCandidate: leg/neighbor anchor opportunities; protect counter and leg junction

S.protectedIdentity: preserve continuous flow and neck; no counter assumed for current master
S.bubbleCandidate: smooth curve tension; maintain upper/lower distinction
S.straightBlockCandidate: angular-flow authored variant; preserve continuous directional read
S.wildstyleCandidate: terminal-led flow; interlock must not pinch neck

T.straightBlockCandidate: straight top bar and vertical stem alignment
T.wildstyleCandidate: bar continuation and top/bottom anchors; avoid accidental extra stem

U.structuralBasis: two stems; continuous base; open top
U.protectedIdentity: preserve open top and continuous base
U.bubbleCandidate: round base transition and terminal treatment
U.straightBlockCandidate: straight stems with controlled base geometry
U.wildstyleCandidate: open-terminal flow and base adjacency; don't close opening

V.bubbleCandidate: soften vertex without rounding into U
V.wildstyleCandidate: vertex clearance and diagonal continuation; avoid fragile slivers

W.protectedIdentity: preserve multiple valleys and distinct diagonal rhythm
W.bubbleCandidate: round valleys while retaining repeated structure
W.straightBlockCandidate: straight diagonal rhythm; manage overall width

X.protectedIdentity: preserve crossing order and four-arm identity
X.bubbleCandidate: soften central junction; preserve four arms
X.straightBlockCandidate: straight diagonals with explicit crossing/over-under choice
X.wildstyleCandidate: explicit crossing order; no implicit shared stroke

Y.structuralBasis: upper fork; lower stem; branch junction
Y.protectedIdentity: preserve fork and descending stem continuity
Y.bubbleCandidate: round fork transition while retaining branch identity
Y.straightBlockCandidate: straight fork arms and stem alignment
Y.wildstyleCandidate: fork anchors and stem flow; explicit crossing order if overlapped

Z.protectedIdentity: preserve bar/diagonal attachments and corner integrity
Z.bubbleCandidate: soften corners and terminals without losing diagonal
Z.straightBlockCandidate: straight bars and diagonal with controlled junctions
Z.wildstyleCandidate: bar continuation and diagonal flow; preserve corner clearance
